summary: The construction is valid for every n >= 7. The complete convex support, parity classes, and full reflected rows are correctly identified; all canonical quantities retain the original law and normalization. The exact atom and full-reflection formulas, strict active inequality, uniform upper bound for A_full, and diverging lower bound for nu are correct. The displayed barycentric inequality also correctly rules out a positive log-concave extension, and the four-point identity rules out globally affine Gibbs weights. No mathematical errors or gaps were found.
